[color=#ffffff]-[/color] Welcome to [color=#ff1c18][pulse freq=3.0 color=#ffffff64 ease=-100.0]MY ROLE IN THE GRAND SCHEME[/pulse][/color]!

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] In the dark and grimy alleys of [color=#ff8864]NEW-CAELUM[/color], you're a former... well, that's not important anymore. What matters now is that you're a [color=#ff8864]PRIVATE EYE[/color], navigating a city full of [color=#ff8864]corruption[/color], [color=#ff8864]crime[/color], and [color=#ff8864]shadowy secrets[/color]. Every case is a [color=#ff8864]puzzle[/color], and you must use all your wits and resources to [color=#ff1c18]piece it together[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] As you dive deeper into lies and hidden truths, you'll need to [color=#ff8864]keep track of everything you discover[/color]. In your office, there's a [color=#ff8864]dedicated space on the wall[/color] where you can [color=#ff1c18]organize your findings[/color] and begin to see the [color=#ff8864]connections[/color] between [color=#ff1c18]clues[/color], [color=#ff1c18]suspects[/color], and [color=#ff1c18]locations[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] Each [color=#ff8864]piece of information[/color] you uncover can lead to [color=#ff8864]new revelations[/color], and your job is to [color=#ff8864]link[/color] these discoveries - sometimes with [color=#ff1c18]threads of certainty[/color], other times with [color=#ff1c18]threads of suspicion[/color]. Slowly, the larger picture will take shape, and you'll start to understand how each [color=#ff1c18]person[/color], [color=#ff1c18]object[/color], and [color=#ff1c18]location[/color] is part of the [color=#ff8864]story[/color].

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] You'll [color=#ff1c18]arrange[/color] and [color=#ff1c18]rearrange[/color] these [color=#ff8864]pieces[/color], [color=#ff1c18]testing[/color] connections and [color=#ff1c18]discarding[/color] those that [color=#ff8864]don't fit[/color]. It's a constant process of refinement, pushing you closer to solving the case, but also reminding you how easy it is to [color=#ff8864]get lost[/color] in the web of deceit.

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] However, be [color=#ff8864]warned[/color]: [color=#ff1c18]solving a case[/color] [color=#ff8864]often[/color] requires [color=#ff8864]more[/color] than just uncovering [color=#ff1c18]one culprit[/color], [color=#ff1c18]one piece of evidence[/color], and a [color=#ff1c18]motive[/color]. The truth is rarely that simple. You'll need to dig deeper, challenge your assumptions, and sometimes even [color=#ff8864]question the facts you've uncovered[/color]. The answers are [color=#ff8864]never[/color] as clear-cut as they may seem at first.

   [color=#ffffff]-[/color] In [color=#ff8864]NEW-CAELUM[/color], [color=#ff1c18]solving a case[/color] brings [color=#ff8864]more[/color] than just [color=#ff1c18]financial relief[/color]. It brings you [color=#ff8864]one step closer[/color] to uncovering the [color=#ff1c18]dark heart of the city[shake rate=7.0 level=5 connected=0]...[/shake][/color]
